basic_profile.bio: I'm a university student majoring in Computer Science, currently residing in Salt Lake City. I enjoy exploring new technologies and often find myself diving deep into programming-related topics. During my free time, I like reading sci-fi novels and watching quirky shows like 'Dirk Gently'. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and occasionally during lunch breaks. I work part-time as a tutor at a local community center, helping kids with basic programming skills. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people online to expand my horizons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of computer programming, primarily gained through my university courses and personal projects. I'm particularly interested in web and mobile development, which is why I engage with subreddits like AskProgramming to clear up my doubts and learn from others' experiences.
